duplicate_vendor.description: Vendors sharing the same GSTIN but registered under different names

round_number_invoice.description: Invoice amount that is a round number (divisible by 1000 with no paise)

late_payment.description: Payment made more than 30 days after the due date

no_purchase_order.description: Transactions above Rs 10,000 with no associated purchase order

disputed_invoice.description: Invoices currently in a disputed status

duplicate_invoice.description: Invoice numbers appearing more than once across transactions

spending_spike.description: Transaction amounts exceeding 2 standard deviations above dataset average

vendor_concentration.description: Vendors accounting for more than 12% of total cumulative spend

split_payment.description: Multiple transactions to same vendor clustered just below round policy threshold
split_payment.rule: recurring vendor transactions in 45k-50k or 90k-100k ranges

field_definitions.gstin: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number — unique per legal entity
field_definitions.has_purchase_order: Boolean — whether a valid PO was raised before invoice
field_definitions.payment_date: Date on which payment was actually released
field_definitions.status: Current state: Paid, Pending, or Disputed
